attribution.localizedCause: LibNC forms every FF1 matrix-gradient element by accumulating the 32-stream dot from zero with sequential fused FMAs, adds the decoded prior BF16 gradient after the dot, and rounds to BF16 once per chronological state.

decision.rationale: Expand the uniform post-dot-add kernel prospectively across all 6,144 ff1_19 output rows and require exact parity against the retained full gradient before using it as an open backpropagation boundary.

hypothesis.rationale: The post-dot prior-add treatment matched all 131,072 LibNC words exactly, including the independent reverse-state and sign-negated controls, while both alternative arithmetic controls retained their prospectively frozen 43 mismatches.

retiredDimensions: LibNC dependency for the attributed 128-row ff1_19 gradient slice
Prior-initialized FMA and nonfused arithmetic as source-exact FF1 matrix-gradient kernels
transferableLessons: The source-exact open FF1 matrix-gradient kernel is dot-from-zero, post-dot prior addition, and one BF16 state-boundary materialization; it transfers exactly to reverse-state and sign-negated populations.

reasons: The revision-bound post-dot kernel completed two byte-identical five-population evaluations; exact treatment, reverse, and negated comparisons passed; the two frozen 43-word controls reproduced; and dependency, source, memory, disk, and cleanup guards passed.
